details.note:
The sealed correction answers the former gate, supersedes its proposed four-cause options, and leaves no genuine interface choice. Direct test-first construction is authorized; no Plan is required.

Exact smallest contract: keep Coder unchanged and stop modeling Fixer as a Coder extension. Nonblank strings are trim-checked and objects reject additional properties. Plan is exactly `{status:"planned",report}` or `{status:"refused",report,remainingScope,blocker}`. Apply is exactly `{status:"completed"|"refused"|"partially_completed",report,classResults}`. `blocker` is `{cause:"authority_violation"|"prerequisite_unmet",evidence}`; no third cause or generic safety escape exists. `classResults` is nonempty, with unique comma-free names, and is a discriminated per-finding union: completed is `{name,disposition:"completed",searchScope,exceptions,commitSha}`; refused is `{name,disposition:"refused",remainingScope,blocker}`. `exceptions` remains an array of exact `{where,reason}` records and means inspected same-class locations requiring no repair, never executable unfinished work. Each completed result requires a full lowercase 40- or 64-hex Git object ID, unique among completed results, preserving per-class commit accountability. Remove Fixer's top-level `commitSha` and `classesRepaired` leaf.

Combination law: plan has no apply result array or partial status. Apply `completed` contains only completed results, `refused` only refused results, and `partially_completed` at least one of each. Partial therefore means completed findings plus lawfully refused findings, not progress or unfinished workload. Every refused result carries its own cause, evidence, and remaining scope; plan refusal carries the assignment-level equivalent. `authority_violation` means executing assigned scope would contradict controlling authority. `prerequisite_unmet` means a concrete assignment-domain prerequisite needed for lawful execution is absent. Package/provider/authentication/auditor/tool transport or execution failures abort/nonzero and never become either blocker. While executable authorized work remains, Fixer continues; caller cancellation or nonzero execution exit are the only unfinished-work exits.

Runtime/auditor boundary: after singleton and structural/phase validation, every candidate attempt gets a fresh `runComplianceAudit` call using `context.model` and credentials, with exact Fixer Soul, exact packet, phase, `transcriptFromContext(ctx)` invocation record, and candidate. It checks only demonstrated Soul/packet/invocation-record compliance, including honest coverage and lawful dispositions. It must not repair, retry work, decide finding merit, route the receipt, or adjudicate it. Pass returns the unchanged candidate and audit usage. Revise throws a specific nonterminating submission error, allowing corrected resubmission and a fresh audit. Malformed audit output or audit authentication/provider/transport failure crosses `failInfrastructure`, aborts, sets nonzero in print/json mode, and produces no receipt.

Soul owner-direct correction: replace the old generic `无法安全完成` refusal sentence with exactly `只在当前指派无法合法执行时拒绝；只要仍有已授权、可执行的工作，就持续施工。` Add no enum/field/runtime prose and no blacklist of workload, time, context, safety, or other pseudo-refusals. This sentence remains an owner direct edit under CLAUDE.md; factory construction does not own Soul bytes.

Package/Recorder/docs boundary: split package validators/types as needed so Coder stays byte-compatible while Fixer hard-cuts. `terminating-tools` and Recorder validate only the new current Fixer union; successful Fixer acceptance carries the package audit observation/usage just like other audited roles. Update public exports, generated `dist`, package lock/lifecycle and packed artifact consistently. Update README Fixer/composition/Recorder sections, the contributor packet and development-closure stale non-claims, and forward-amend ADR 0015 terminology where it would contradict the new contract. Existing sealed dockets remain byte-unchanged even though their old Fixer leaves are not accepted at current head. Packet composition, compatibility grouping, dispatch, invocation budget, stopping, sequencing, contextual reconciliation, and next-hop acceptance remain caller-owned; no scheduler/orchestrator is authorized.

Required reds: old prose-only/top-level-commit/classesRepaired leaves; third/generic causes; blank evidence or remaining scope; duplicate names or completed commit IDs; malformed commit IDs; homogeneous arrays labeled partial; mixed arrays labeled completed/refused; partial-as-unfinished; plan/apply cross-shapes; workload/elapsed/incomplete labels and dishonest relabeling reaching audit revise rather than acceptance; auditor redo/adjudication overreach fixtures; malformed/auth/provider/transport audit failures; and Recorder accepting an unaudited or legacy current Fixer lifecycle. Required greens must traverse the real TypeBox submission schema and production validator for every legal plan/apply shape, prove multi-class and mixed settlements, fresh same-active-model ordering and resubmission, nonzero infrastructure exit, unchanged candidate projection, Fixer audit observation in Recorder, public exports, typecheck/full tests, `build:recorder`, and `npm pack` contents.
